photo_usable.instructions: The photo is sharp and lit well enough, and shows the product fully enough, to judge its condition.

category_match.instructions: The product in the photo is {category}.

damage_visible.instructions: Physical damage is visible (crack, dent, broken part, burn, swelling).

signs_of_use.instructions: Signs of use are visible (scratches, scuffs, dirt, dust in ports, worn coating, fingerprints on glossy surfaces).
